summary: Rabbi Tawil explains the meaning and structure of the final two requests in the middle section of the Amidah, specifically focusing on the prayers for the Davidic line and for Hashem to hear our voices. He discusses the nature of growth and redemption through the imagery of planting, and explores the halakhic guidelines for inserting personal requests into the prayer.
questions: Why is the redemption of the Davidic line compared to planting a tree?
What is the significance of the word 'pe' in the prayer 'Shma Koleinu'?
Is it appropriate to add personal requests to the Amidah?
Should we expect immediate results after praying for our needs?
How does the concept of not appearing empty-handed apply to our daily prayers?
